barRaise.topFinding: Yesterday's review produced real code for the first time in two weeks, and the most important of those fixes broke the game. Retiring DEBUG_INFINITE_RESOURCES (de46692) turned on a resource cap clamp that had been inert since v0.32.2, and the caps are pinned at 50 for biomass, aggregate, alloy and volatiles because the only thing that raises them is the Warehouse, which costs 80 biomass and is never registered with economy.register_warehouse anyway. 14 of 37 buildings and 4 of 5 research techs are now permanently unaffordable, the authored start-resource exports at world_3d.gd:27-31 are clamped away, and the endless-resources toggle does nothing. The three fixes also shipped with no version bump: they self-stamp v0.99.41 in four code comments while project.godot, the GDD pill, the changelog and every live YaE surface still read 0.99.40, because the drain marked each queue item completed on the code change alone and skipped the release_note the item itself carried. Underneath that, the review machinery is now the loudest thing in the project: the HBH queue went from 39 items to 110 in one day, 104 of them have never been attempted once, and every one is auto_safe=false, which is why this run deliberately capped its own auto-enqueue at ten.

barRaise.reconcileNote: Full 35-lens fan-out 2026-07-25. Skip-unchanged gate did NOT fire: three commits landed since the 2026-07-24 run (63c4534, de46692, 0d4f2ae), two of them substantive code, so this pass ran as re-verification of the 2026-07-24 finding set plus new-defect detection on the changed code. Health 71, down from 73. Four previous actions closed on evidence: playability-05 (DEBUG_INFINITE_RESOURCES now a runtime var defaulting false), reliability-02b (F5/F9 gated on not _game_over plus _clear_end_state), per-project-ps1-stack-02 (Confirm-GitIntact restores $LASTEXITCODE on both exit paths), and cost-economics-01 (its frozen-tree premise is falsified). No BLOCK: both hard_rule_checks re-verified independently (GDD tail </html>; colorblind_mode declared once at options.gd:30). The dominant new finding is playability-09: retiring the dev economy turned on a cap clamp that pins four resources at 50 with no reachable cap-raiser, so 14 of 37 buildings and 4 of 5 techs are unaffordable. AUTO-ENQUEUE WAS DELIBERATELY CAPPED at 10 of 23 uncovered findings, because work-queue-hygiene-03 and strategic-kill-this-07 independently measured the HBH slice growing 39 to 110 in one day with 104 of 110 never attempted and auto_safe=false on all 110; the 13 held ids are enumerated in the report and re-enter the candidate set next run. Queue coverage was verified by exact (project, finding_id) suffix match rather than substring, which surfaced skill-chain-handoff-integrity-07: architecture-04 and work-queue-hygiene-02 were reported enqueued by the 2026-07-24 run and exist in neither the queue nor the archive.
